The '''Galactic Alliance Mid Rim Fleet''' was a major [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] formed in the years before the start of the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. The prior habit of numbering Defense Force fleets was largely dropped in favor of naming fleets to the specific region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] they were assigned to defend.<ref name="LECG" />
